name: iac_filter
description: Reports the outcome of selecting which unmanaged cloud resources should be imported into Terraform. This tool must be called as the final action, after evaluating the user's query against the list of unmanaged resource IDs and the exception list.

selected_resource_ids.description: The provider-native resource IDs selected for import. Each ID must come from the unmanaged candidates list. IDs in the exception list must never appear here. An empty array means no resources matched the query.

explanation.description: A concise rationale for the selection: which resources were chosen and why, which were excluded by the exception list, and why any unmanaged resources were not selected. When the array is empty, this text is shown to the user as the UNCOMPLETED rationale.
